models.official_lgbm: Balanced LightGBM on Morgan+RDKit, official labels only (control)
models.pool_lgbm: Balanced LightGBM on Morgan+RDKit, official + pseudo-negative labels
models.gate_x_tdi: P(log2fc < -1) from calibrated LightGBM log2fc regressor x official_lgbm probability
models.pool_chemeleon: Balanced logistic regression on standardized CheMeleon, C in {0.01, 0.1, 1} by inner group-fold AP, official + pseudo-negative labels
models.gate_x_tdi_chemeleon: As gate_x_tdi with CheMeleon features for gate and TDI head
models.rank_mean_gates: Equal percentile-rank mean of gate_x_tdi and gate_x_tdi_chemeleon
models.legacy_sep15_refit: Comparator: seed-averaged nested OOF of run 20261002T120413515280Z-f2330789

config.rate_selection: Pooled test-like MCC on the other outer folds; ties go to the lower rate
config.status: Validation-design probe; no candidate, submission or upload

gate_choice: LightGBM regressor on D6 primary log2fc (all screened training molecules), Platt-calibrated to P(log2fc < gate_threshold) on inner group-fold OOF predictions
caveats: Pseudo-negatives assume primary non-hits would be assigned negative
Blind molecules were not primary screened; the test-like pool is an analogy
Rates and models are evaluated on umap/scaffold families only
Blind rank-based calls do not establish the blind scored-label mask
